T: Go ninja, go ninja, go eat.
D: The Turtles return to stop Shredder from making new mutants with the last of the ooze.
P: Bring out the snacks when the Turtles start the rap in the club.
S: scooped straight from the research canister

Mash avocado with lime juice and salt, fold in finely diced red onion, coriander and chilli, press plastic wrap on the surface until serving. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and salt. Fold in half a finely diced red onion, a handful of chopped coriander and 1 chopped red chilli. Press plastic wrap on the surface until serving so it stays green. Serve with 300g corn chips.
the turtles never stop at one pizza
Split mini bagels topped with pizza sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, grilled until bubbling. Split 12 mini bagels and spread each half with pizza sauce.
Keno, the pizza delivery kid who joins the fight

Pizza dough rolled around tomato, pepperoni and mozzarella, sliced into scrolls and baked golden with a garlic butter glaze. Roll 500g pizza dough into a 40 x 30cm rectangle. Spread with 120g pizza sauce, then scatter 100g sliced pepperoni and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll up tightly from the long side and cut into 12 slices. Place on a lined tray and bake at 220C for 15 to 18 minutes until golden. Brush with 30g butter melted with 1 crushed garlic clove and parsley.
M: pizza for every meal in the turtles' new hideout

Toasted sub rolls loaded with beef meatballs in pizza sauce, pepperoni and melted mozzarella, grilled until bubbling. Mix 500g beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, 30g parmesan, salt and pepper, and roll 16 meatballs. Brown in oil for 5 minutes, add 400g pizza sauce and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through. Split 4 sub rolls, toast lightly, fill with meatballs, sauce and 50g pepperoni, and top with 200g grated mozzarella. Grill for 3 minutes until melted.
never pay full price for late pizza

Thin base with tomato sauce, mozzarella, pepperoni, fresh pineapple and sliced jalapeño, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rest 2 balls of pizza dough, about 500g, at room temperature for an hour. Stretch thin, spread with 200ml pizza sauce and top with 250g grated mozzarella, 100g pepperoni, 200g fresh pineapple pieces and 1 sliced jalapeño. Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting for 8 minutes.
W: Tokka and Rahzar mint choc shakes
two mutant babies, one shake each

Blend 3 scoops of mint choc chip ice cream with 200ml cold milk until thick, pour into chilled glasses. Blend 12 scoops mint choc chip ice cream, about 750ml, with 800ml cold full cream milk until thick and smooth. Pour into four chilled tall glasses and serve with straws.
K: Ooze canister lime and kiwi slushie
a safe batch of ooze, nothing mutagenic in it

Kiwifruit, lime juice and lemonade blitzed with ice into a bright green slush, served with a fat straw. Peel and chop 4 kiwifruit. Blend with 60ml lime juice, 2 tbsp honey and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Add 400ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix without losing the fizz. Pour into 4 glasses, add a lime wheel and serve with thick straws.

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature so it relaxes. Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch the dough thin into a large rectangle or round on a tray. Spread with sauce and mozzarella.
Top one quarter each with pepperoni, sausage, mushroom and capsicum.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, in two batches if needed.

dishes.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature so it relaxes. Season the tomatoes with salt.
Stretch the dough thin across two large trays. Spread with sauce and mozzarella.
Scatter over the pepperoni, sausage, mushroom and capsicum.
Bake on preheated trays at the oven's highest setting until golden and bubbling, one tray at a time. Cut into big squares to feed four brothers and a dad.
Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm milk into a sticky dough.
Cover and leave to rise until puffy.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into oil heated to 180C and fry in batches until golden all over. Drain.
Shake the hot puffs in a bag with the icing sugar and serve.
